# qovery_git_token (Data Source)

Reads an existing Qovery git token, without its value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qovery_git_token" "my_git_token" {
  id              = "<git_token_id>"
  organization_id = "<organization_id>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the git token.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization.

### Optional

- `bitbucket_workspace` (String) Bitbucket workspace the token has access to. Set only when `type` is `BITBUCKET`.
- `description` (String) Description of the git token.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the git token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Value of the token: a personal access token or an app token of the git provider. Always `null`: the API never returns it.
- `type` (String) Git provider of the token.
